invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new or existing partitioner, never null.
The method accesses strategyParams without null checks, so it must not be null.
schema is passed to addMetadataFields without a null check, so it must not be null.
If the key is present, the returned object is always a JavaCustomColumnsSortPartitioner.
When the key is not present, result is an instance of BulkInsertPartitioner (by definition of the method).
